# Marginalia

> Free, single-file web app to annotate Markdown documents with inline notes and export a clean, structured context package for AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini.

Marginalia runs entirely in the browser. There is no sign-up, no server, and no data
leaves the user's device. The user loads a Markdown document, highlights any passage,
attaches a note or question, and exports a structured bundle (quoted passage, section
location, surrounding context, and notes) to paste into an AI assistant for review.

## Features
- Inline, anchored Markdown annotations (margin-rail, Google-Docs style)
- Highlight a passage and attach a question, comment, or edit request
- Export modes: full context, notes only, or raw Markdown
- Renders GitHub-flavored Markdown and Mermaid diagrams
- Keyboard accessible, responsive, light theme, prefers-reduced-motion aware
- 100% client-side: no tracking, no account, no upload
